evidence_classes.workspace-measured: Measured on this workspace's own renders or reference corpus (none yet; see specs/creative-intelligence-report.md).
evidence_classes.adopted-unverified: Taken from Motionmaxxing's published measurements; its corpus is private and the numbers were NOT reproduced here. Use as a starting default, never as a limit.
evidence_classes.convention: Common animation practice; no measurement is claimed.

note: Durations are [min, typical, max] seconds and are starting values for a style profile to override, not rules. Eases use GSAP core only (no CustomEase plugin).

vocabulary.name: Decelerating entrance
vocabulary.use_when: Most things arriving on screen: travel front-loaded, long soft tail.
vocabulary.avoid_when: Playful or physical styles that want a bounce; use settle-lean instead.

evidence.note: Motionmaxxing reports 58% of landings are ease-out and a median translate/scale entry of 12 frames (0.4 s) over 50 moments; corpus private, not reproduced.

vocabulary.name: Arrive from oversize
vocabulary.use_when: Hero object or logo: arrives large and settles, so it feels placed, not grown.
vocabulary.avoid_when: Small supporting items; grows-from-zero is a different, weaker idea.

evidence.note: Motionmaxxing craft law 7 (arrival decelerates from oversize). Treated as a starting point; counter-example: calm/archival styles.

vocabulary.name: Masked rise
vocabulary.use_when: Headlines and key words: text rises through an overflow mask.

evidence.note: Standard kinetic-type practice; implemented by the runtime.

vocabulary.name: Uneven stagger
vocabulary.use_when: Sibling groups (letters, rows, tiles): onsets 1-3 frames apart with uneven gaps, tails overlapping.
vocabulary.avoid_when: Two or three items; uniform delay reads as a loading list but may suit a rigid grid style.

evidence.note: Motionmaxxing rule R1.8 (uneven gaps); unverified here.

vocabulary.name: Accelerating exit
vocabulary.use_when: Things leaving: ease-in then out of frame or shrink.
vocabulary.avoid_when: When the exit is itself a reveal (use a wipe).

evidence.note: Motionmaxxing reports 37% of leaves are ease-in vs 16% of landings; unverified here.

vocabulary.name: Fade a single object
vocabulary.use_when: One object that should dissolve (breath, memory, privacy, calm styles).
vocabulary.avoid_when: Between whole scenes in a style that wants momentum.

evidence.note: Motionmaxxing argues against default fades; its own judgment doc lists calm brands as an exception. Context decides.

vocabulary.name: Small late lean (overshoot)
vocabulary.use_when: A physical reward: a card docks, a stamp lands. At most once or twice per film.
vocabulary.avoid_when: Every element; data and legal copy.

evidence.note: Motionmaxxing reports overshoot on under 9% of moves, mostly late and small; unverified here.

vocabulary.name: Damped settle
vocabulary.use_when: Heavy objects, cinematic reveals; no overshoot.

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Mask wipe reveal
vocabulary.use_when: Reveal a figure, line or label by uncovering it in the direction of reading or of cause.
vocabulary.avoid_when: Wipes between unrelated scenes (nothing motivates the direction).

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Stroke draw
vocabulary.use_when: Lines, paths, charts: the drawing is the explanation.

evidence.note: Convention; linear draw keeps data honest.

vocabulary.name: Rack-focus reveal
vocabulary.use_when: Cinematic: blur resolves onto the subject.

evidence.note: Convention; blur radius should be driven by the style profile.

vocabulary.name: Camera push-in
vocabulary.use_when: Build attention toward one subject over a beat; scale 1.00 to about 1.06.
vocabulary.avoid_when: When there are several co-equal subjects.

evidence.note: Convention; the workspace's earlier report used 1.00 to 1.06.

vocabulary.name: Camera pull-out
vocabulary.use_when: Reveal context or scale after a close detail.

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Lateral tracking
vocabulary.use_when: Scanning a timeline, a list or an environment; constant velocity feels like a dolly.

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Parallax drift
vocabulary.use_when: Layered scenes: layers move at different speeds for depth.

evidence.note: Convention; rule of thumb uses 3 to 6 layers.

vocabulary.name: Vertical descent
vocabulary.use_when: Journey through layers or depth (ocean, atmosphere, a stack).

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Rotation / turntable
vocabulary.use_when: Showing an object from another angle.

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Shape morph
vocabulary.use_when: One thing becoming another where the identity carries over.

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Assemble / disassemble
vocabulary.use_when: Showing how parts make a whole.
vocabulary.avoid_when: When the whole is the point.

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Match cut
vocabulary.use_when: Shape, position or motion carries across a cut; the eye keeps the object.
vocabulary.avoid_when: No shared geometry between shots (do not force it).

evidence.note: Film convention.

vocabulary.name: Directional push
vocabulary.use_when: Direction means something: forward in time, down a hierarchy.

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Zoom through
vocabulary.use_when: Entering an object or scale change.

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Liquid / shape cover
vocabulary.use_when: Organic, playful or paper styles.

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Hard cut on motion
vocabulary.use_when: Energy, shock, or when the incoming shot is already moving; the cut should mean something.
vocabulary.avoid_when: Between calm, still shots (looks like an error).

evidence.note: Motionmaxxing: cut on motion, never on rest; treated as an option, not a rule.

vocabulary.name: Slow dissolve
vocabulary.use_when: Passage of time, reflection, archival feel.

evidence.note: Convention.

vocabulary.name: Designed breath
vocabulary.use_when: Before a payoff or after a reveal; keep one living element (drift, grain, light).
vocabulary.avoid_when: Over narration that is still giving information.

evidence.note: Motionmaxxing allows 0.6-1.5 s breaths with a stated reason; unverified here.

vocabulary.name: Intentional stillness
vocabulary.use_when: A frame that should simply be read or felt (title, quote, a single figure). Declare intent: still.
vocabulary.avoid_when: Over spoken explanation of changing content.

evidence.note: Stillness is legitimate; it must be declared so QA records a waiver and not a silent pass.

vocabulary.name: Emphasis pulse
vocabulary.use_when: Spoken keyword gets a brief highlight.

evidence.note: Convention.
